guarantees.claim: msg_mask_permuted is driven to a permuted version of msg_mask: for each i from 0 to MsgWidth-1, msg_mask_permuted[i] = msg_mask[RndCnstMsgPerm[i]]; bits beyond MsgWidth-1 are set to 0 by the initial '0 assignment.

assumptions.claim: All elements of RndCnstMsgPerm must be within the range 0 to sha3_pkg::MsgWidth-1, ensuring the index into msg_mask is valid.
assumptions.risk: Out-of-bounds indexing of msg_mask causes undefined behavior (X propagation in simulation, unknown synthesis result), which can corrupt the mask and break side-channel protection.

uncertain_points.claim: RndCnstMsgPerm must be a full permutation of {0..MsgWidth-1} to preserve masking entropy; duplicates or omissions would weaken side-channel resistance.
uncertain_points.cond: unknown how RndCnstMsgPerm is generated; requires inspection of sha3_pkg definition.
uncertain_points.risk: A non-bijective permutation could create bit correlations in the permuted mask, reducing masking effectiveness and exposing secret data to power/timing attacks.
